vibe: Forensic, analytical, terminal-inspired, cyber-intel. No generic purple/violet AI-slop. Deep obsidian backdrop with teal and neon amber accents.

headings.usage: Use for primary app title, dashboard section headers, and major typographic moments. Never use Inter for headings.

body.usage: Use for all conversational text, chat bubbles, and descriptive paragraphs.

mono_data.usage: Use for all data points, latency metrics, risk scores, node counts, query history tags, and code snippets.

visual enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for the analysis panel, header, and floating modals. backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B1215]/70 border border-[#00F0FF]/10. Never use pure transparent backgrounds.
visual enhancers.shadows: Ambient glows instead of drop shadows. e.g., shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.1)]
visual enhancers.textures: Include a subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) over the entire dashboard to kill digital flatness and enhance the 'intel terminal' feel.

grids.base: Bento Grid protocol Mode B (High Density). grid-cols-12 system.

layout_structure.analysis_graph: col-span-12 md:col-span-4 (Graph visualizer and metrics panel)

grids.spacing: Dense but legible. gap-4 or gap-6 for dashboard widgets. p-6 for inner container padding.

layouts.app_shell: h-screen w-full flex flex-col md:flex-row overflow-hidden bg-background-base text-text-primary
layouts.cards: Flat background with 1px subtle border, sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-md). Use 'The Grid Borders' aesthetic for the analysis section to look like technical readouts.
layouts.alignment: Strict left-alignment for chat bubbles and analytical data. Center alignment is banned except for empty states or standalone metrics.

motion.stepper: Sequential staggered opacity and translate-y transitions for the 7-stage retrieval pipeline.
motion.chat: Smooth translate-y for new messages. Framer-motion for layout shifts when the analysis panel expands.
motion.graph: Smooth zoom and pan. Nodes should pulse when corresponding data is retrieved in the pipeline.
motion.transitions: Use specific transition properties, NOT 'all'. e.g., transition: opacity 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet APCA standards. All neon text must have sufficient contrast against the deep obsidian background.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, pipeline steps, badges) MUST include descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='send-query-button', data-testid='neo4j-connect-modal').

media.icons_library: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight for a sharp, technical look).
media.charts_library: recharts. Use for the Risk trend line chart. Style with deep dark backgrounds and neon stroke lines (#FFB347 and #00F0FF).

graph_visualization.usage: Use 2D for high performance with custom canvas node rendering (circles with phosphor green or cyan glow). Set background to transparent to blend with UI. Interactive highlighting on hover.

image urls.description: Geometric tunnel with glowing teal lights. Use as a full-bleed, heavily dimmed background for the Google Sign-in landing screen to establish the cyber-intel theme.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize Tailwind config with the exact hex colors provided in the 'colors' object. Define custom properties for low/med/high risk.
Create the 7-stage pipeline as a vertical 'stepper' component in the Analysis panel, highlighting the active step with teal/amber accents.
For the Knowledge Graph, use react-force-graph-2d. Style the links as thin white/teal lines (opacity 0.2) and nodes as glowing dots.
Build Shadcn customized components. Replace standard border radii with sharp or max-rounded-md edges.
Ensure the analysis panel uses IBM Plex Mono for latency and metrics for a technical aesthetic.
DO NOT create any .tsx files. Use .js and .jsx exclusively.
Use standard HTML div elements and framer-motion for the layout. Avoid Shadcn 'Card' wrappers if they restrict layout flexibility.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). NEVER use pure transparent backgrounds under text.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like sharp, technical buttons with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Add data-testid attributes to ALL buttons, inputs, links, and major UI components for testing.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications, configured for dark mode with border colors matching the notification type.
